 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 3 06-08-2025 Heard the parties.
2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Cyber P.S. Case No. 09 of 2024, registered for the offence under Section 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per prosecution case, the accused persons are said to have committed rape with the victim girl.
Subsequently, it has come that the petitioner has recorded the private moment of victim girl and made it viral.
The mobile recovered from the petitioner contains the video of the victim girl.
The petitioner is in jail since 24.04.2024.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has not committed any offence.
The Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.27117 of 2025(3) dt.06-08-2025 petitioner has clean antecedent.
5. Learned A.P.P. has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
